entities.title: Cloudflare's invocation logs
entities.summary: Observability is on for the Worker, so Cloudflare records its invocations; the code writes nothing of its own.
entities.name: Workers Logs for cyberspace-explorer
entities.meaning: One entry per request the Worker handles, as Cloudflare records it.
entities.readBy: Members of the Cloudflare account that owns the Worker.
excludes: Anything about a sign-in: app.js has no logging calls, and README.md says nothing is logged about a sign-in.
entities.details: How long the entries are kept, and exactly what they hold, is set by Cloudflare, not in this repository.
